page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c2g1.large is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance powered by the KVM hypervisor on an x86_64 CPU architecture. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs paired with 8.0 GB of system RAM, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by a single NVIDIA P4 GPU equipped with 8 GB of VRAM. The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps and carries no bundled local disk storage, necessitating remote network storage for persistent operating system and data requirements.

The low vCPU count combined with entry-level discrete GPU hardware offers a cost-efficient profile for lightweight GPU tasks. Suitable workloads include basic AI model inference, small-scale media encoding, and GPU software development or testing environments that do not require high multi-core CPU capacity.
